note: _init_receipt_errors validates worker identity, the reported model path, and the declared recurrent depth BEFORE init_done/lane=ready are committed; failure clears identity+recurrence state and feeds the one-shot handshake retry.
title: Init status ok is marked ready before recurrence and identity validation

note: A failed durable-owner release leaves the lane in a named 'fenced' state and lane_recovery_required() returns a partial-failure receipt with the owner id and fencing token; the cold transition is reached only on a confirmed release.
title: Durable owner release failure still returns a cold successful abort

note: The stale-after budget a foreground holder declares travels with its ownership; eviction is judged against the holder's own contract floored at 30s, and a holder that declared nothing is never evicted on age.
title: A latent caller's timeout controls stale-owner eviction

note: Clean-cancel acks must bind to this request id, this request payload sha256, and this worker (boot id, pid, model path) using fields the receipt already carried; unbindable acks are recorded as degradations.
title: Clean latent cancellation acknowledgement is not request-bound

note: The cancel path applies _terminal_contract_refusal (proof completeness, operator-evidence merit, capability grounding) and withholds a partial that fails one; retries stay skipped because the turn was preempted, but refusing is not a retry.
title: Soft cancellation bypasses output sanitization and all terminal contracts

note: The salvage suffix no longer asserts that the description comes from Aura's own state and self-model - a provenance claim the runtime cannot support. It states only a limit, still satisfies the boundary guard, and the repair stays disclosed in applied_repairs.
title: Deterministic salvage invents first-person state evidence

note: The declared-format detector now covers bounded counts, structured serialisations (JSON/CSV/YAML/code fences), brevity requests and schema directives, so the generic 3-6 sentence proof shape is imposed only on genuinely open-ended tasks.
title: Proof rendering imposes an unrelated three-to-six-sentence answer shape

note: Verified at HEAD: an incomplete proof after exhausted retries sets proof_contract_incomplete, which is emitted in the generate payload, so callers get the FAILED verdict rather than only a log line.
title: Incomplete proof output remains eligible after retries are exhausted

note: Verified at HEAD: the capability-inventory quality-gate waiver requires _capability_inventory_minimum_grounding and records an explicit exemption plus the waived reasons; an ungrounded clipped draft stays failed.
title: Rejected capability inventory drafts are relabeled as passed

note: Verified at HEAD: set_expert_adapter validates the requested adapter and refuses unrestorable wrappers BEFORE detaching, and an attach failure rolls back to the previously resident adapter instead of unwinding to the bare model.
title: Adapter replacement destroys the previous identity before validating the new one

note: Verified at HEAD: the per-token inserts were replaced by a single post-generation insert where the cache object exactly matches the final token list, so no shorter prefix key can alias later-prefix KV state.
title: Per-token cache entries alias the same mutable prompt-cache object

note: Verified at HEAD: the thread budget is derived from the actual host (explicit AURA_MLX_NUM_THREADS wins, otherwise cores minus two for the parent runtime, floor 4) instead of a hard-coded 10.
title: Worker thread counts are hard-coded for one hardware profile

note: Enforced end to end: the worker records a degradation when required recurrent depth fails to apply and reports it truthfully in recurrent_depth status, and the client's _init_receipt_errors refuses READY when required depth is missing, inactive or mismatched.
title: Required recurrent depth can be inactive while initialization reports ok

note: fine_tune_type is constrained to lora/qlora before any weight mutation (pure validation, model untouched on refusal), and attach verifies the actual module tree: an unrestorable wrap or a load that wrapped nothing is unwound and refused. Embedding restore was already fixed.
title: Expert adapter detach cannot restore every adapter type or full-weight mutation

note: Privileged contract selection is HMAC-signed with a per-spawn key handed to the worker at fork, binding job id, action, principal and the sorted field set; the worker refuses unsigned or tampered selections, and exclusive contracts are refused even when signed. Scope stated honestly: this is provenance, confused-deputy resistance and tamper evidence, NOT a new security perimeter, since a forger would already be inside the parent process.
title: Caller-controlled booleans select privileged proof and surface behavior

note: Candidate selection now uses the gate's mean-centered cosine for all n via two matvecs (same asymptotic cost as the distance scan); measured on an anisotropic store the old Euclidean selector ranked the correct neighbour 60th of 61 and it now ranks 1st. Degenerate queries on the common direction return nothing and are counted.
title: Candidate selection and confidence gating use incompatible metrics

note: The lane-lease handle is kept until release is confirmed; a failed release retains the lease plus a lane_lease_release_failed record and raises a critical degradation, so stranded ownership stays actionable.
title: Unload discards lease state before release succeeds

note: AURA_EMBODIED_CHALLENGE requires an explicit ON value; '0'/'false'/'no'/'off'/'disabled' and unrecognised values no longer disable the mandatory search handoff.
title: Any nonempty embodied-challenge environment value disables mandatory search handoff

note: Recalled memory is rendered inside an explicit boundary with type/source provenance and role-marker neutralization; snippets cannot forge their own tags, attributes are sanitized, and length is bounded. Applies to dict and bare-string memories alike.
title: Memory content is accepted as prompt-ready text without provenance or instruction isolation

note: WeightIntegrityProof carries parameter and canary digests plus erased layer ids; integrity_verdicts() reports proven/refuted/unproven and names claims their own evidence refutes. Refuted is fatal everywhere; proven is required for published certification claims. Remaining: the digest PRODUCER (cheap canary hash around the episode) is not yet implemented.
title: Integrity booleans and runtime identity fields are assertions without proof linkage

note: The universal-causal-audit claim is removed and narrowed to the one direction the digest supports; a first_logits_digest_spec binding prevents comparing digests computed under different methods.
title: The first-logits digest is overstated as a universal causal audit

note: Worker identity now carries ordered adapter identity, tokenizer artifact digests and the quantization/dtype layout, each reporting its absence as a named gap in worker_stack_identity_gaps.
title: Adapter, tokenizer, quantization, and dtype identity are absent

note: Provenance parsing is defensive: a bare string is one issue not many characters, a non-iterable becomes a typed issue, a truthy non-mapping cannot reach .get, and counts coerce to 0 instead of raising.
title: Malformed provenance shapes can crash runtime identity collection

note: A vanilla control must positively declare every enhancement OFF (absent = undeclared, not disabled), must show no activity counters, and must match a preregistered control_decode_spec.
title: The vanilla control contract does not exclude hidden enhancements

note: The 32B class claim additionally requires architecture and quantization identity alongside the manifest-derived parameter count.
title: 32B classification is inferred from one unverified integer

note: The service gate reads digest evidence rather than the booleans: a refuted verdict is fatal, and certification requires proven. PARTIAL by design - the digest producer is still to be built, recorded in the commit message rather than claimed.
title: Fast-weight cleanup is proven only by worker booleans
